article.headline: Foot injury ends Grant's streak of starts
article.story:
LUBBOCK, Texas (AP) -- Cisti Greenwalt scored 19 points and had
15 rebounds to lead No. 12 Texas Tech to a 66-55 victory over Rice
on Monday night.

Tech's Erin Grant sat out with an injured foot, breaking a
string of 68 consecutive starts.

Greenwalt hit 7-of-18 from the field and 5-of-8 from the free-throw line for the Lady Raiders (1-0). Alesha Robertson added 18
points for Texas Tech.

Michelle Woods led Rice (2-2) with 15 points and 11 rebounds.
